Package mesos.am30.gameModel

package mesos.am30.gameModel
Package for the Game Model definition.
This Package contains the definition and implementation of the Game Model for the Game "Mesos"; in particular have been defined the core parameters for the Game, as well as the Player itself.
More specific definitions/implementations can be found in the following sub-Packages:
  • mesos.am30.gameModel.board: Game logic implementation.
  • mesos.am30.gameModel.card: all type of Cards definition.
  • mesos.am30.gameModel.event: all Events definition.
